CODEX audit response — masque v0.4.0 → v0.4.1

Source: critical_review_codex_2026-05-18.md

Date: 2026-05-18 Source audit: synthPR_dev/audit_CODEX_20260518.md (Codex, 2026-05-18) Baseline: masque at feat/rpkg-audit-fixes-2026-05-17 HEAD faf08e0 Response branch: feat/v0.4.1-codex-fixes (stacked on the audit branch) New tag (proposed, not yet cut): v0.4.1

Verdict

CODEX’s audit was substantive and constructive. Eleven findings: three behaviour fixes (fail-closed levels, integrity check, atomic pass-through), three correctness fixes (leakage denominator, geo NA source, multi-treatment guard), four doc / hygiene items, one versioning decision. Of those, nine landed in code on the v0.4.1 branch; one (CODEX #10, A2b Imports cap) is deferred to a later maintenance bump per CODEX’s own steer; one (CODEX #7, version tag decision) is answered by bumping to v0.4.1 and submitting from there.

Post-fix evidence:

  • R CMD check --as-cran on masque_0.4.1.tar.gz: 0 errors / 0 warnings / 2 NOTEs (both environment-only: new submission, HTML Tidy). The third NOTE CODEX saw (CRAN incoming feasibility / GitHub URL 404) is conditional on the repo visibility flip and is now documented in cran-comments.md.
  • R CMD check --as-cran subset of tests: 421 PASS / 4 SKIP / 0 FAIL / 0 WARN (vs. CODEX baseline 403 PASS / 4 SKIP / 0 FAIL / 3 WARN).
  • devtools::test() full local suite: 451 PASS / 0 SKIP / 0 FAIL / 0 WARN (vs. CODEX baseline 422 PASS / 0 SKIP / 2 FAIL / 3 WARN). The two CODEX-flagged ERRORs on test-mask-end-to-end.R:97 and test-mask-roundtrip-integration.R:88 are gone (those tests now call propose_roles(df, detect = FALSE) to preserve v0.2.x byte-stable semantics until joint-treatment masking lands).
  • Invariant scorecard (12/12) preserved from the prior /rpkg audit close-out; no regression.

Per-finding disposition

# CODEX finding Severity Disposition Where it landed
1 detect = TRUE × single-treatment mask() high (local suite) Land minimal. Improved roles_validate() error message (drops stale “v0.2 / deferred to v0.3”; guides to detect = FALSE or role edit). MET tests patched to use detect = FALSE. Lifting the single-treatment cap is a v0.5+ design item (“Joint-treatment masking” on vignette("roadmap")). R/roles_validate.R; tests/testthat/test-mask-end-to-end.R; tests/testthat/test-mask-roundtrip-integration.R
2 unmask() atomic numeric pass-through high (round-trip ergonomics) Landed. Atomic numeric / integer / logical / Date-like vectors pass through unchanged in both single-map and no-map recipes. The column argument, if supplied, is still validated against rec@roles$col for early feedback. New tests cover all four atomic types. R/recipe_apply.R; tests/testthat/test-recipe-apply.R (3 new tests)
3 Silent NA on unknown mapped level high (fail-closed retargeting) Landed. .apply_level_map_forward() and .apply_level_map_inverse() now cli::cli_abort() with the offending values (utils::head(bad, 5L)) and a fix hint, instead of coercing to NA. New tests for both directions on unknown levels. R/recipe_apply.R (new .fail_unmapped() helper); tests/testthat/test-recipe-apply.R (2 new tests)
4 Recipe integrity fingerprint stored but unused medium-high Landed. New internal .check_recipe_integrity() enforces the SHA-256 NA-mask fingerprint on apply_recipe() calls. New parameter apply_recipe(..., check_integrity = TRUE) is the documented default; FALSE is the escape hatch for workflows where missingness has legitimately changed. Three new tests: positive, negative, escape-hatch. The order in apply_recipe() is missing-column check → integrity check → drop / subset / map so structural errors win over fingerprint errors. R/check_integrity.R (new); R/recipe_apply.R; tests/testthat/test-recipe-apply.R (3 new tests)
5 audit_mask() exact-match-pct denominator medium Landed. .compute_audit() now divides by the number of jointly-observed comparable cells, not by nrow(df). The audit tibble gains a new comparable_n column. The pre-existing leakage threshold rules remain unchanged in semantics; their numbers are now honest in the presence of NAs. R/leakage.R; tests/testthat/test-audit_mask.R (named-columns assertion updated)
6 synthesise_geospatial() NA-mask source medium Landed. Now uses original’s NA mask as the cell-by-cell authority (previously used synth’s). Added nrow(synth) == nrow(original) validation. Two new tests: positive (synth full + original NA → output respects original) and negative (row-count mismatch → error). R/synthesise_geospatial.R; tests/testthat/test-synthesise_geospatial.R (2 new tests)
7 Version-tag decision medium Decided: bump to v0.4.1, submit from there. v0.4.0 is left local-only (never published); v0.4.1 is the public release that bundles the audit-close-out docs + CODEX corrections. DESCRIPTION bumped. NEWS.md carries a full v0.4.1 entry describing the two behaviour changes and the bug fixes. DESCRIPTION; NEWS.md
8 CRAN comments / NEWS staleness medium Landed. cran-comments.md rewritten: notes v0.4.1 supersedes the unreleased v0.4.0; describes up-to-3-NOTE envelope (new submission, HTML Tidy, GitHub URL while private); flags the visibility-flip dependency for the third NOTE. NEWS.md v0.4.1 section dropped hard-coded NOTE counts. cran-comments.md; NEWS.md
9 Stale planned-version docs low-medium Landed. Doc sweep: removed mask.R’s “arrive in build-order steps 6-7”; reworded recipe_io.R’s include_simulator = TRUE v0.2 / v0.3 phrasing; rewrote vignettes/roadmap.Rmd to drop hard version pins (use feature-area headings + “What has already landed” recap); refreshed vignettes/recipe_anatomy.Rmd and vignettes/getting_started.Rmd similarly. Rd files regenerated via devtools::document(). R/mask.R; R/recipe_io.R; vignettes/recipe_anatomy.Rmd; vignettes/getting_started.Rmd; vignettes/roadmap.Rmd (rewrite); man/*.Rd (regenerated)
10 /rpkg elegance polish (E5 Imports trim, etc.) low Deferred per CODEX’s own recommendation. MASS::mvrnorm could be replaced with a small Cholesky draw; the other six non-base imports are load-bearing. Snapshot tests (A2.3) also queued. None of this blocks v0.4.1; tracked on the maintenance backlog. — (no v0.4.1 changes; queued)
11 Test WARNs → expect_warning() low Landed. Three jitter tests that intentionally trigger the collaborate-mode HIGH-leakage warning now wrap with expect_warning(m <- mask(...), "HIGH leakage"). (Note: the assignment must live inside expect_warning() because testthat 3rd edition’s expect_warning() returns the warning condition, not the value; the first batch attempt of this fix had the assignment outside and failed on class(m)[1] == "simpleWarning".) tests/testthat/test-synthesise_numeric_jitter.R (3 wraps)

Two additional doc edits not in CODEX’s list

While doing the doc sweep, two further stale strings surfaced in R/roles_validate.R that match CODEX finding 1 in spirit:

  • The non-numeric-outcome error string still said “v0.2 supports numeric / integer outcomes only” — reworded to “mask() currently supports only …” with no version pin.
  • The roxygen \itemize{} bullet listing the multi-treatment hard error reworded similarly.

These are tagged in the commit body, not in CODEX’s report.

Cleared false positives (carried forward from prior /rpkg audit)

The /rpkg audit driver’s credential-leak scan flagged three strings last week. All verified safe under the same logic this week:

  • R/propose_roles.R PII-detection regex literals.
  • .github/workflows/R-CMD-check.yaml ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}.
  • The prior critical_review_2026-05-17.md (gitignored as a working note).
